aspect: It is the act of assembly, not of discovery
description: Each item may be individually public. Collecting and publishing them together is what creates the harm.
energy_note: All of it was findable. None of it was collected.

aspect: Platforms treat it as the user's problem
description: Analysis of platform risk assessments found technical infrastructure for image removal but, for doxxing and harassment, mitigation centred on educational materials encouraging self-protective practices - responsibility shifted to the target.

aspect: Moderation is inconsistent and measurably so
description: Analysis reported up to 22% of moderated images as potential false positives, alongside documented cases of moderators intervening on some threads and declining on others.
energy_note: Enforced unevenly, and the unevenness is measured.

description: Nobody threatens her. Somebody posts the name of her employer. Somebody else posts the road. A third person posts 'just so people know'. Moderation finds no rule broken in any single post.
energy_note: Three posts, no rule broken, and she moves house.
